title: Clair3 OUT — normalized per-variant call row
description: One row per (sample, biallelic variant) emitted from a Clair3 VCF after bcftools norm + bcftools view filtering. Multi-allelic sites must be split before this schema applies. Source: Modules/03_clair3.

variant_id.description: Canonical variant identifier in the form '{chrom}:{pos}:{ref}:{alt}' after left-normalization. Must be unique per (chrom,pos,ref,alt) across the joint VCF.

pos.description: 1-based VCF position of the leftmost affected base.

alt.description: Single ALT allele. Multi-allelic sites must be split upstream (bcftools norm -m -any).

ploidy.description: Genotype ploidy. 1 only on contigs declared haploid for this sample in the Clair3 manifest.

dp.description: Per-sample read depth at this site (VCF FORMAT/DP).

ad_ref.description: Read count supporting REF. From FORMAT/AD.

ad_alt.description: Read count supporting ALT. From FORMAT/AD.

gq.description: Genotype quality (FORMAT/GQ). Null if Clair3 did not emit GQ for this call.

filter.description: VCF FILTER column. 'PASS' for variants passing all filters; otherwise a semicolon-joined list (e.g. 'LowQual').

is_snp.description: True if len(ref) == 1 and len(alt) == 1 and both are A/C/G/T.

phase_set.description: FORMAT/PS phase-set ID when the call is phased; null when unphased.
